description: This Java class 'ModifyAclEntryStrategy' implements a command handling strategy for modifying Access Control List (ACL) entries within a 'Thing' entity in a persistence context. It processes 'ModifyAclEntry' commands, validates changes, and generates appropriate events and responses, including creation and modification of ACL entries.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: A final, immutable class that implements a command strategy to handle 'ModifyAclEntry' commands for 'Thing' entities, including validation, event creation, and response generation.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy for applying a 'ModifyAclEntry' command, updating the ACL and generating appropriate events.

methods.name: getAclValidator
methods.description: Creates a new ACL validator instance for the given ACL to ensure it meets required permissions.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing ACL entry or create a new one based on current ACL contents, returning the corresponding result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Builds and returns a result indicating an ACL entry has been modified, including generating the modification event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Builds and returns a result indicating a new ACL entry has been created, including generating the creation event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' entity state related to the ACL entry, used for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the entity tag for the 'ACL entry' after modification or creation, used to verify the entity version.
